channel.title: West Hawaii Today - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from West Hawaii Today (westhawaiitoday.com)

item.title: Patriots Opening Night notebook: DC Terrell Williams happy to be back
item.description: SAN JOSE, Calif. — Terrell Williams is back with the New England Patriots in time for the Super Bowl.

item.title: NBA roundup: Grizzlies overcome Anthony Edwards, end Timberwolves’ streak
item.description: Jaren Jackson Jr. had 30 points, Ty Jerome added 19 points with eight assists, and Jaylen Wells scored 18 to lead the Memphis Grizzlies to a 137-128 victory Monday night over the visiting Minnesota Timberwolves to snap a six-game losing streak.

item.title: With Sean McVay and Les Snead re-signed, Rams wait on Matthew Stafford decision
item.description: LOS ANGELES — Coach Sean McVay and general manager Les Snead signed extensions that will keep them with the Los Angeles Rams for at least several more years.

item.title: Kealakehe Elementary breaks ground on $16M classroom building
item.description: Kealakehe Elementary School has begun work on a $16 million classroom building that will expand learning space, better serve a growing student population, and physically connect the school’s upper and lower campuses.

item.title: Hawaii lawmakers consider allowing residents to kill feral chickens
item.description: Hawaii residents could be allowed to kill feral chickens in their community in the latest effort to help resolve a perennial issue that continues to divide neighbors who both hate and love the birds.

item.title: Big Island man sentenced to nearly six years in prison for housing credits scam
item.description: The first of four Big Island men convicted of a scam involving Hawaii County affordable housing credits was sentenced Friday in federal court.

item.title: Spittlebug threatens Hawaii Island’s cattle industry
item.description: The two-lined spittlebug arrived on Hawaii Island in 2016.

item.title: Hilo man accused of hitting his father with a hammer, charged with second-degree attempted murder
item.description: A 48-year-old Hilo man is facing an attempted second-degree murder charge for allegedly hitting his 68-year-old father in the head with a hammer.

item.title: Trump had unusual call with FBI agents after election center search
item.description: By any measure, the FBI’s search of an election center in Fulton County, Georgia, last week was extraordinary. Agents seized truckloads of 2020 ballots, as President Donald Trump harnessed the levers of government to not only buttress his false claims of widespread voter fraud, but also to try to build a criminal case against those he believes wronged him.

item.title: Trump, in an escalation, calls for Republicans to ‘nationalize’ elections
item.description: WASHINGTON — President Donald Trump called in a new interview for the Republican Party to “nationalize” voting in the United States, an aggressive rhetorical step that was likely to raise new worries about his administration’s efforts to involve itself in election matters as he and his allies continue to make false claims about his 2020 defeat.
